object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make an uncommitted change, with no pending edits. Record the working-copy files (untracked ones too), the git index, every reference and the latest commit, and compare the latest commit with the working copy both ways. Expected: nothing recorded has changed. Repeat for two commits, an issue, a typed version, a failing comparison, a comparison from the Compare dialog, and one from the MCP server.
